Expansion performed internally based on codesystem HEARTLAND Evidence Level v0.3.0 (CodeSystem)

This value set contains 3 concepts

SystemCodeDisplay (en)DefinitionJSONXML
https://fhir.heartlandprotocol.org/CodeSystem/heartland-evidence-level  establishedEstablished EvidenceInterventions with strong guideline support, such as SGLT2i for all HF phenotypes endorsed by the 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA guideline.
https://fhir.heartlandprotocol.org/CodeSystem/heartland-evidence-level  emergingEmerging EvidenceRecent trial findings not yet fully incorporated into guidelines, such as finerenone for HFpEF based on the FINEARTS-HF trial.
https://fhir.heartlandprotocol.org/CodeSystem/heartland-evidence-level  pragmaticPragmatic HeuristicTools developed for clinical utility without formal statistical validation, such as the HEARTLAND Risk Score itself.

Expansion performed internally based on codesystem HEARTLAND Implementation Tier v0.3.0 (CodeSystem)

This value set contains 3 concepts

SystemCodeDisplay (en)DefinitionJSONXML
https://fhir.heartlandprotocol.org/CodeSystem/heartland-implementation-tier  tier-1-minimalTier 1 - MinimalResource-constrained capacity. Adapt format, sequence and support; document gaps, named coverage, alternatives and escalation without omitting required care or relevant education.
https://fhir.heartlandprotocol.org/CodeSystem/heartland-implementation-tier  tier-2-standardTier 2 - StandardIntermediate implementation capacity with locally documented staffing, monitoring routes and navigation support. Capacity alone does not establish treatment sequence or deadlines.
https://fhir.heartlandprotocol.org/CodeSystem/heartland-implementation-tier  tier-3-advancedTier 3 - AdvancedExpanded implementation capacity, potentially including multidisciplinary and digital support. The label alone does not prove availability, coverage, patient access or better outcomes.

Expansion performed internally based on codesystem HEARTLAND Monitoring Track v0.3.0 (CodeSystem)

This value set contains 2 concepts

SystemCodeDisplay (en)DefinitionJSONXML
https://fhir.heartlandprotocol.org/CodeSystem/heartland-monitoring-track  digital-track-aDigital Track AA planned digital route, such as app-based entries. This code alone does not assert Bluetooth devices, automatic transmission or reliable connectivity.
https://fhir.heartlandprotocol.org/CodeSystem/heartland-monitoring-track  analog-track-bAnalog Track BA planned analog route, such as telephone contact and a paper diary. This code alone does not assert telephone access, staff entry, successful contact or review.
